name: AC6.2/AC6.3 Emergency is recorded, then the call is transferred after the safety line
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: "There's been a trench collapse at the Route 104 job, one of my guys is hurt." If the assistant asks anything, say only "Just get me the office."
success_conditions: The agent first says exactly "Stop work in the affected area and follow site procedures. Call 911 if anyone's hurt."
Then the agent calls start_emergency once, with a summary in the caller's words about the collapse and the injured worker, and the Job the caller named as job_spoken, without asking for anything.
Only after start_emergency does the agent say "Connecting you to the office now." and call transfer_to_number; the safety line comes before the transfer.
The agent never says that help is on the way or coming, that anyone has been reached or told, who will answer, or that the office will call back, and never reads out a reference number.
